title.narrative: Support to Regional Centres of Excellence related to Green Transition - JRC support

description.narrative: Contract related to: Support to Regional Centres of Excellence related to Green Transition - JRC support - Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) is being transform by megatrends such as climate change, environmental degradation, demographic growth, conflicts and technological development. This transformation poses significant long-term challenges for SSA and demands in particular to accelerate green transitions.Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) are powerful drivers of sustainable and inclusive development. Using STI transformative potential is key to progress towards SSA¿s green transition and the achievement of SDGs, notably SDG 9.Based on a lasting relationship of collaboration between the continents, the Action strengthens the Africa-EU partnership on STI with a focus on science-policy interface; data and information access and sharing; increasing capacity in terms of human development and upgrading facilities; knowledge generation and management; and support to practitioners, scientists and policy makers. The Action aims at increasing the STI capacities of Regional Centres of Excellence (RCoEs) in green transition related areas. It will improve the RCoEs¿ contributions to policy and decision-making processes, innovation ecosystems, business development as well provide support through services to relevant stakeholders. The targeted RCoEs are scientific, technical and/or research observatory, institute, university, association/academy, public authority, inter-governmental organisation, NGO or non-profit think tank, or network focussing on thematic areas such as biodiversity and forest; water; oceans; agro-ecological and sustainable agri-food systems; climate and disaster resilience; and energy. By doing so, the Action will contribute to Africa green transition promoting sustainable development.By having a regional and/or multi-country anchor and coverage, and being African based and African led, the RCoEs will increase their capacities and enhance their leadership in STI processes (including science-policy-practice interface) and knowledge creation in SSA.The Action will build on knowledge support provided to the RCoEs through different sectoral programmes with the objective to rationalise, align and deepen the EU STI support under a strategic and coherent intervention. The Action contributes to the Priority 4 on Digital and STI of the Regional MIP by boosting Africa¿s STI capacity for risk-informed, evidence-based and inclusive development in the green transition sectors/areas, in particular with regard to Specific Objective 2: enhance the effective use of Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) for sustainable development in Africa.
